_comment: Source scripts for the five demo calls. `text` is what an ASR would emit; `say` (optional) is what the speech synthesiser reads when it differs (digits, codes). `at` = absolute start in seconds, `gap` = seconds after the previous utterance ends, `endAt` = place the utterance so it ends at this time (used to stage an interruption). Run scripts/synthesize_audio.py to regenerate public/audio/*.mp3 and src/data/generated/heroTimings.json.
